map.人工晶体(IOL)度数(SRK-T)计算器 使用指南: Intraocular Lens (IOL) Power (SRK-T) Calculator User Guide
map.输入眼轴(AL)、角膜曲率(K)与 IOL A 常数，计算 IOL 度数并支持目: Enter the axial length (AL), corneal curvature (K) and the IOL A constant to compute IOL power, with support for a target refraction reserve.
map.SRK II：P = A′ − 0.9K − 2.5L（A′ 随眼轴分段校正）；: SRK II: P = A' - 0.9K - 2.5L (A' corrected piecewise by axial length); SRK/T: P = 1336/(AL - ELP) - 1336/(1336/K - ELP), ELP = pACD + H, pACD = 0.62467A - 68.747, R = 337.5/K, H = R - sqrt(R^2 - (Cw/2)^2)
map.SRK II 为线性回归式；SRK/T 用 vergence 公式并以 ELP（: SRK II is a linear regression formula; SRK/T uses the vergence formula with ELP (effective lens position) correction. The target refraction is back-calculated from vergence: P = 1336/(AL - ELP) - 1336/(1336/K - ELP) - target refraction. Each 1 mm error in axial length affects the result by about 2.5 D.
map.SRK-T 用有效晶体位置 ELP 计算：P = 1336/(AL−ELP) −: SRK-T calculates with the effective lens position ELP: P = 1336/(AL-ELP) - 1336/(1336/K-ELP).
map.SRK-II 经验式作对照。: SRK-II empirical formula used as a comparison.
map.白内障术后目标屈光度规划。: Target refraction planning after cataract surgery.
map.：若 AL=26，则 ELP 与分母变化使 P 降至约 16–17D，轴长越长所: : If AL = 26, changes in ELP and in the denominator lower P to about 16-17 D; the longer the axial length, the lower the power needed.
map.房水/玻璃体折射率约 1.336，故以 1336 mm 作为眼内介质折射率常数。: The refractive index of the aqueous humor and vitreous is about 1.336, so 1336 mm is used as the refractive index constant of the intraocular medium.
map.它用回归求得有效晶体位置 ELP 而非经验修正，对极端眼轴更可靠。: It uses regression to obtain the effective lens position ELP rather than an empirical correction, making it more reliable for extreme axial lengths.
